_doc: Runtime config for the paper deployment. Copy to config/paper.json. No secrets here: API keys come from the secrets backend.

secrets._backends: file (config/secrets.json, gitignored) | env (AT_ALPACA_KEY_ID / AT_ALPACA_SECRET_KEY / AT_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / AT_FMP_API_KEY / AT_FINNHUB_API_KEY / AT_WATCHDOG_TOKEN) | aws-secretsmanager (secret name in 'aws_secret_name')

validator._anthropic_workspace_id_doc: Required when the Anthropic API key is org-level (not scoped to a workspace); the API rejects such requests without the anthropic-workspace-id header.
validator._allowed_domains_doc: Reuters/AP/WSJ/FT/MarketWatch/Barron's block Anthropic's crawler; including any of them makes the API reject the whole search request.
validator._timeout_doc: Measured 10-17s per candidate (2 API calls + up to 3 web searches). Validation runs overnight between the 16:20 ET signal and the 09:31 ET entry, so a tight deadline only manufactures ERROR verdicts.
